apps.name: Cypher Drive
apps.return_to_launcher: Use the app's Return to Launcher item where shown.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV HID payload launcher build.

apps.name: ESP32 BT HID
apps.return_to_launcher: Press backtick, Esc, or Del from the top-level device list.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV BLE-HID payload deck with SD-backed DuckyScript payloads and Cypher OS return support.

apps.name: ESP32 Pokedex
apps.return_to_launcher: Choose Return to Cypher OS from the home menu.
apps.notes: Offline Cardputer Pokemon GO field guide using existing SD data under /pokemon, /audio, and /config.

apps.name: Cypher Chat
apps.return_to_launcher: Use the app's Return to Launcher item where shown.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV secure-only mesh chat build. Mesh protocol 0x02 uses AES-256-GCM and does not interoperate with plaintext or HMAC-only firmware.

apps.name: Cardputer Games
apps.return_to_launcher: Use the app's Return to Launcher item where shown.
apps.notes: Standalone Cardputer arcade catalog.

apps.name: Cardputer MPC
apps.return_to_launcher: Press Shift+Q to return to Cypher OS. Lowercase q remains an MPC pad trigger.
apps.notes: MPC-style groovebox with SD-loaded samples and sequencing.

apps.name: Cardputer Tarot
apps.return_to_launcher: Back/backtick from the main menu returns to Cypher OS.
apps.notes: Offline tarot pull, journal, history, and study deck app.

apps.name: Cypher PN532
apps.return_to_launcher: Use Return to Cypher OS, or press Del, Tab, backtick, or Q from the main menu.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV PN532 NFC app using EXT I2C on G8/G9 with SD-backed dumps, read-only SD web browser, and return-to-launcher support.

apps.name: Cypher Desk
apps.return_to_launcher: Use Return to Launcher from the app menu.
apps.notes: Offline Cardputer ADV utility suite with notes, calculator, checklist, converters, and scratchpad.

apps.name: Flock You
apps.return_to_launcher: Open the mini menu, cycle to HOME, then press up/down to return.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV WiFi/BLE detector build with return-to-launcher support.

apps.name: WireTap-32 Cardputer
apps.return_to_launcher: Choose Launcher from the main menu, or type launcher / return over serial.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV EXT bench build with return-to-launcher support.

apps.name: Drone Mesh Mapper
apps.return_to_launcher: Open the Launcher page, then press BtnA, Enter, or Space.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV Remote ID drone scanner with WiFi/BLE detection, SD logging, and Cypher OS return support.

apps.name: Cypher AirTag
apps.return_to_launcher: Choose Return to Cypher OS on the Settings page, press backtick on the Radar page and confirm with Enter, or type return over serial.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV passive Apple Find My / AirTag detector with following alerts, locate beeps, SD JSONL logs, and Cypher OS return support.

apps.name: Bitcoin Card Wallet
apps.return_to_launcher: Choose Return to Cypher OS from the main menu.
apps.notes: Offline Bitcoin wallet utility from the Cardputer App Bundle with Cypher OS launcher return support.

apps.name: Cardputer Game Station Emulators
apps.return_to_launcher: Press Fn+Del from the ROM menu or pre-game screens after quitting gameplay safely.
apps.notes: Cardputer emulator launcher from the Cardputer App Bundle, built with the bmp wrapper linker flags.

apps.name: ESP32 Bit Pirate
apps.return_to_launcher: Type launcher, return, cypher, or home at the prompt, or press Fn+Del in standalone mode.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV hardware bus and protocol toolkit from the Cardputer App Bundle.

apps.name: ESP32 USB Stick
apps.return_to_launcher: Eject or unmount the USB disk from the host, then press Fn+Del.
apps.notes: Cardputer USB mass-storage SD bridge from the Cardputer App Bundle.

apps.name: News Reader
apps.return_to_launcher: Press Fn+Del.
apps.notes: Guardian-backed Wi-Fi news reader from the Cardputer App Bundle. Requires SD config at /news-reader/config.txt.

apps.name: Open WiFi Scanner
apps.return_to_launcher: Press Fn+Del.
apps.notes: Open-network scanner from the Cardputer App Bundle with Cypher OS return support.

apps.name: Password Manager
apps.return_to_launcher: Choose Cypher OS from the no-vault home menu.
apps.notes: Offline Cardputer password vault from the Cardputer App Bundle with launcher return support.

apps.name: Ultimate Remote
apps.return_to_launcher: Choose Cypher OS from the main menu.
apps.notes: Cardputer ADV remote-control utility from the Cardputer App Bundle.

imports.name: Cardputer Game OS Games
imports.return_to_launcher: Use the imported game's launcher return control where documented.
imports.notes: Imports individual game .bin files from the sibling Cardputer Game OS build manifest.
